description: Parking à moins de 100m d'un arrêt de bus is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées Atlantiques. Analyse géomatique des parkings du Département des Pyrénées-Atlantiques pour lesquels sont raccrochés l'information des arrêt de bus à moins de 100m. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. The portal shows 1,825 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
